name: ibanforge
description: The compliance API for AI agents — IBAN validation, BIC/SWIFT lookup, Swiss BC-Nummer clearing (the only API with SIX BankMaster data), EMI/vIBAN classification, SEPA + VoP reachability and compliance risk scoring.

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Validate one IBAN and enrich it: BIC/SWIFT, country, EMI/vIBAN issuer class, SEPA + VoP reachability, risk indicators, and Swiss bc_nummer for CH/LI. Cost: $0.005 USDC.

tools.name: batch_validate_iban
tools.description: Validate up to 100 IBANs in one call. Cost: $0.002 USDC per IBAN (e.g. 100 IBANs = $0.20).

tools.name: lookup_bic
tools.description: Resolve a BIC/SWIFT code into bank name, country, city and LEI. Backed by 121,399 BIC entries. Cost: $0.003 USDC.

bic.description: BIC code (8 or 11 characters, e.g., UBSWCHZH80A)

tools.name: lookup_ch_clearing
tools.description: Resolve a Swiss BC-Nummer / IID into institution name, type, SIC/euroSIC participation and QR-IID. The ONLY API exposing this SIX BankMaster data (1,190 entries). Cost: $0.003 USDC.

iid.description: Swiss IID / BC-Nummer (1-5 digits, e.g., 762 for UBS Switzerland)

tools.name: check_compliance
tools.description: Pre-flight compliance triage on an IBAN: bank-BIC-level sanctions screening (OFAC/EU/UN/SECO) + FATF jurisdiction flag + SEPA Instant reachability + VoP (EU 2024/886) participant + risk score 0-100. Informational, not a regulated AML/CFT product. Cost: $0.02 USDC.
